integrity_statement: An analytical proof is supplied for all stated quantifiers. The included checker tests finite cases only. No independent validation or historical-priority certification is asserted.
limitations: The exact column formula assumes even state-space order n=2m.
Only a lower asymptotic bound, not an exact asymptotic, is proved for the unweighted l1 time-weighted derivative constant.
Prior theorem equivalence in the full classical Ehrenfest literature is not independently ruled out.
title: A logarithmic endpoint derivative gap for the Ehrenfest semigroup
